checks.detail: Assembler bundles exactly the noncanonical manifest pins plus PREPARATION_MANIFEST.json, IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW.json, TEST_RECEIPT.json, and README.md; verifies pinned bytes, substitutes frozen manifest/runtime/canonical pins, compiles inline and assembled script, and records transport identity.

Launch body enforces UID 1061 and B ownership, physical B scratch, exact absent unit/create-only paths, empty campaign cgroup descendants, scoped parent path, 2-CPU parent, exact configured 18/20 GB and zero swap caps with observed page-rounded kernel caps, reservation/headroom/disk floors, selected GPU campaign ownership, and repeats the gates before launch. Resource observation supports the page-rounding check.

Only manifest-pinned R10 source plus the four frozen extras are staged after byte/size/SHA checks. ROOT_ADMISSION and ROOT_LAUNCH bind the exact command, return code, post-launch properties, and InvocationID; the command sets 0.5 CPU, 1.4/1.5 GB, zero swap, 600 seconds, CUDA hidden, single-threaded BLAS, physical-B TMPDIR, and RemainAfterExit.

Root inline smoke pins the runtime closure, patches NumPy load/memmap to fail before importing the four R10 modules, rejects preloaded/new WNN/PyArrow/Torch imports, records ROOT_IMPORT_SMOKE, then execs the frozen CLI. The CLI and staging body verify metadata/pins before fit array mapping; no target/eval data path is configured.

Capture helper requires the matching successful ROOT_LAUNCH and exact InvocationID, exited/success/zero status, expected caps and runtime, then preserves small selected receipts as base64 with original-byte length/SHA; inventories output by stat only and captures scoped parent events. Empty terminal ControlGroup remains null and never falls back to host-root cgroup.
Stop helper re-reads ROOT_LAUNCH and the exact unit properties, verifies the same invocation, terminal success, and caps before stopping only the named unit, then verifies inactive/dead state.

launch_binding.root_operator_requirement: Capture only after terminal state and exact invocation/cap checks; validate raw payload lengths and SHA-256 locally and durably before invoking the exact-stop helper.

limitations: The capture helper is success-path-only: it asserts FAILURE.json is absent, so it is not suitable for preserving a failed R10 run. If failure evidence exists, do not call this helper; preserve failure through a separately reviewed metadata-only path.

The capture helper checks the 4,000,000-byte receipt limit only after read_bytes() has loaded the file. This bounds transport size, not peak read allocation; selected receipts and probe.log are expected to be small, and no array/model payload paths are selected.

This is a static review of the pinned artifacts, not a scientific-result acceptance. Independent local raw-byte durability, length/SHA verification, and producer/result schema checks remain required before exact stop.
scope: Independent static pre-capture review of the frozen R10 transport, launch body, root inline smoke/exec, terminal capture helper, and exact-stop helper. No remote commands or capture/stop actions were executed by this review.
